AIRBAG

LP cover that

deploys itself.

Insurance for Uniswap v4 liquidity providers that pays out by itself · live on Arbitrum Sepolia

Airbag is insurance for liquidity providers on Uniswap v4. When a price move costs you money, the payout lands in your wallet by itself. No claim form.

THE PROBLEM

Liquidity providers earn fees, then lose more than they earned.

01 · LPS LOSE

49.5%

of Uniswap v3 liquidity providers did worse than if they had just held the two tokens.

Source: Loesch et al., Bancor & Topaze Blue, 2021

02 · LOSS BEATS FEES

$260M

lost to price moves (impermanent loss), against $199M earned in fees, in the pools studied.

Same study · May–Sep 2021

03 · NO COVER

<2%

of the value held in DeFi is insured, and the cover that exists pays after a claim and a vote.

Source: bex.co, May 2026

AIRBAG2
Liquidity providers earn fees, but when the two tokens move apart they lose money compared with just holding them. That is impermanent loss. In one study of Uniswap v3, half of LPs lost money this way, and the losses were bigger than the fees. Almost nothing in DeFi is insured, and what is insured pays slowly.

HOW IT WORKS

Six steps. The buyer does two.

  1. 1The underwriter opens a market. 1M USDC stays in their own wallet; 1inch Aqua only records it.
  2. 2The buyer adds liquidity to a Uniswap v4 pool that has our hook.
  3. 3The buyer pays a premium and gets a cover note.
  4. 4The hook measures the loss on-chain, from the pool's own prices.
  5. 5Past 0.5%, Airbag orders the payout through Aqua.
  6. 6USDC goes from the underwriter to the buyer. No claim form.
Airbag gives the order · the money never sits in our contract3
Here is the whole flow. The underwriter opens a market, and the money stays in their wallet. The buyer adds liquidity and pays a premium. The hook measures the loss. When it passes half a percent, Airbag orders the payout, and the underwriter's money goes straight to the buyer.

ONE EXAMPLE

Alice provides $100k of wstETH/WETH liquidity

1

She buys cover

$4,500

= $100k × (5% − 0.5%). That covers every loss from 0.5% up to 5%.

2

She pays a small premium

≈ $7

for 30 days, on the market's price curve. The price rises as more cover is sold.

3

The prices split

−3.18%

wstETH falls 40% against WETH. She is $3,175 worse off than holding.

4

She is paid

+$2,675

Everything above the first 0.5%. If the loss deepens, the difference is paid later.

Payout = (loss − 0.5%) ÷ (5% − 0.5%) × cover · the live LP market's settings4
Alice puts a hundred thousand dollars into the pool and buys forty-five hundred of cover, which is enough to cover every loss from half a percent to five percent. It costs about seven dollars for a month. The price moves, she loses 3,175 dollars against holding, and 2,675 lands in her wallet. She keeps only the first half percent.

WHO PAYS THE CLAIM

Underwriters back the cover and compete on price

1INCH AQUA

The money stays in their wallet

Underwriters approve a reserve through 1inch Aqua. It is not pooled in our contract, so there is no single pot to hack.

RISK CURVE

Each one sets a price

The more cover an underwriter has sold, the higher their price. A router sends every order to the cheapest curves.

TWO INCOMES

They earn twice

Premiums from every policy, plus savings yield on the same reserve. It is only withdrawn when a payout fires.

A market cannot sell more cover than its reserve allows · checked on-chain on every purchase5
Who pays? Underwriters. Their reserve stays in their own wallet through 1inch Aqua. Each sets a price curve, and buyers always get the cheapest. A market cannot oversell its reserve.

UNDER THE HOOD

The contracts behind one payout

For the technical judges: the hook records each position's entry and exit, and the price at the start of each block, so a flash loan cannot fake a loss. CoverApp asks ILTrigger whether a policy is due, and Aqua moves the money from the underwriter to whoever holds the cover note. The keeper has no special rights: anyone can fire the payout.

ONE ENGINE · THREE PRODUCTS

Three kinds of loss, one engine

UNISWAP V4

Liquidity provider loss

A Uniswap v4 hook measures the loss of a pool position on-chain and the cover pays a share of it.

LP loss

STABLECOIN

Stablecoin depeg

Pays the full cover when the coin trades at or below $0.97.

≤ $0.97

TOKENIZED STOCK

Stock gap-down

Pays in proportion when a tokenized stock falls below its strike. A 20% gap pays 20% of the cover.

< $250

New products plug in as a new trigger contract · the reserve, pricing and payout stay the same7
LP loss is one product. The same engine also covers a stablecoin depeg and a stock gap-down. A new product is just a new trigger.

Other cover is discretionary, slow and pooled. Airbag is parametric, automatic, non-custodial and priced by a market, all four at once, and the loss is measured by the pool itself. Tokenomist unlock dates tell an LP when to buy.

HONEST LIMITS

Testnet only and not audited. The price feeds are demo feeds that we move by hand; Chainlink and Pyth adapters are built but not live. Reserves are not locked, and one wallet can back several markets with the same money.
